[2026-08-26T22:10:11.256Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-08-26T22:10:11.256Z] [arbiter] These are the Aetherkin the roadside traders whisper about — the flood-dead the Aether would not let rest.
[2026-08-26T22:10:11.257Z] [world] In life it was a bell-ringer, shoulders rounded from a rope pulled ten thousand times — they could be anyone's — a neighbour, a stranger, the person you'd have been. The silt let go of them all at once, and they came up c
lawing at the light.
[2026-08-26T22:10:11.257Z] [world] There's no hunger in it, only fright. It shrinks from your step, then squares up on trembling legs — it will defend itself, and nothing more.
[2026-08-26T22:10:11.258Z] [world] You push north. The silt is heavy underfoot, the horizon unchanged.
[2026-08-26T22:10:11.258Z] [world] The loose end is exactly as loose as you left it.
